sections.content: The course covers basic programming topics, such as variables, functions and loops, to more advanced topics. Students explore these by self-learning of course materials together with guided programming exercises. Students without the prerequisites but possess relevant programming knowledge may seek instructor's approval for enrolling in the course.
sections.teaching: the lecture notes given by the instructor is complete and useful. and the instructor tried to explained the questions we proposed as mu as possible
sections.grading: This course is pass or  fail course, so the grading is actually not that bad if you treat this course seriously
sections.workload: workload is acceptable. For a beginner without any knowledge in python, it might still need time to digest the course material in order to finish the assignment by yourself.

sections.content: some elementary syntax about python. also introduce some more advanced features(OOP/recursion) in the last part of the course.
sections.teaching: it's based on a self-learning website. nothing much to comment about.
sections.grading:
it's a P/F course.
need to get at least 60% out of 100% of the assignments and 40% of the final exam to pass.
I feel like if you do understand the content, it's easy to pass.
sections.workload:
the workload is adequate for a 1-cre course.
There's an easy assignment once a week and a total of four of them. simply follow the web instruction and it should be done in one or two hours.

sections.content: A introductory course for students who are interested in Python as Python is getting popular in the computer world, especially for Deep Learning development. However, this course is way from sufficient for those keep learners. But considering the short duration, amount of content is acceptable.
sections.teaching: Though videos are already available for demonstration, especially those assignments, it will be even better if videos are also available in course content given the current teaching method is almost texts, making it a bit boring and not friendly to beginners.
sections.grading:
A course with only Pass or Fail.

To pass COMP1029P, you have to fulfil following requirements:
1. on average, 60% or higher of the 4 exercises total mark (at least to submit 3 exercises)
2. 40% or higher in the final exam
sections.workload: 4 lab exercises in total with 1 final exam within the one month duration in Winter semester.

sections.content:
not too many. it is easy for the programming beginners.
there are only 4/5 lectures chapter
sections.teaching: it is a self-learning course and the teaching materials are good. it is easy to understand.
sections.grading:
it is easy to pass, you need to get 40% in exam and 60% in homework.
in my exam, mostly asking you about the output and there are some MC also 1-2 question asked you to write the program.
sections.workload: only have 5 homework in the total semester. Each homework has a teaching video, and you can follow the video to type the program.

sections.content: The content includes basic data type, arrays and dictionaries, for loop and while loop, input and output handling and basic recursion.
sections.teaching: This is an online course, which means that there is no lecture. You need to learn by yourself by reading though the course material in the CSE website.
sections.grading:
This is pass or fail course.
To pass one of these bridging courses, you need to:
obtain 60% or higher of the four exercises total mark, and:
obtain 40% or higher in the final exam
It is extremely easy to get over 40% of grade in the final, so you do not have to worry at all.
sections.workload: Workload is very light. There are four exercises in total, and each takes less than an hour to complete. You only need to complete one exercise every 2-3 weeks.

sections.content:
輕鬆，5個topic: 1. Introduction to Python 2. Essential Programming in Python 3.2D Arrays and the Game of Life 4. Advanced Features 5. Recursion and Object-Oriented Programming; 想學下唔同programming language既同學，或者major requirement需要python(comp1021)既同學不妨試下。雖然教既野都好皮毛，comp course 1字頭level，不過都值得學下。
winter/summer 無聊既話，可以一試～
sections.teaching: 自己上網睇notes（同埋assignment都有video跟住做）。
sections.grading: pass or fail, 如果comp1022p/q有認真學下都幾難fail。
sections.workload:
好細，有少少programming background既話，一睇就明。然後assignment都可以跟住佢段片做。考試都簡單既，1字頭comp level。如果comp1022p/q有好好學習基本上考前求其睇一次都會pass（當然，你reg個course純粹求pass，而唔係想學，咁你reg黎做乜？！？！？！？！？！）。
只要(assignment >=60% && final exam>=40%) 就會 pass。
